newsitem.title: USA: FORE Systems offers low price on ATM switch.
newsitem.headline: FORE Systems offers low price on ATM switch.

text.p: FORE Systems Inc said Monday it introduced an entry-level workgroup switch that delivers Asynchronous Transfer Mode's performance for less than the cost of other high-speed networking alternatives.
The ForeRunnerLE 155 ATM family of switches is priced as low as $650 per port, FORE Systems said.
The company claims it has removed the largest hurdle to mainstream adoption of ATM as a core infrastructure in smart networks, with a price reduction of about 40 percent per port.

"With today's product introduction, we've eliminated cost from the network purchase decision, significantly broadening the range of users who can benefit from ATM," said Ron McKenzie, FORE vice president of marketing.

"But the cost per port is not a true measure of the value of the solution, because with FORE ATM, you're not just delivering a faster connection, you're delivering 'smart bandwidth' over a 'smart network,'" he said.
FORE Systems makes high-performance networking products based on ATM technology.
